installation: dsh plugin --profile web add <verified-local-tarball> --save-exact, then remove the package from global profile bundles so only the explicit restricted preset mounts it
delivery: The private Windows release carries this verified npm tarball. The installer verifies its SHA-256, retains it under the isolated AGENT_RUNTIME_DIR plugin package cache, then uses the official DSH Plugin Manager to install it into the web profile. The plugin tarball is locally bundled; Plugin Manager dependency resolution and supply-chain checks may still access the configured npm registry. GenUI stays opt-in through asset-hub-genui-restricted and is not loaded in every DSH session.
